meta.name: job-stories
meta.description: Create job stories using the 'When [situation], I want to [motivation], so I can [outcome]' format with detailed acceptance criteria. Use when writing job stories, creating JTBD-style backlog items, or expressing user situations and motivations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用JTBD格式写出用户故事和验收条件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常用JTBD方法表达用户动机和场景
copy.tagline_en: Write job stories and acceptance criteria in JTBD format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often use JTBD to express user motivations and scenarios

howto.what: Claude 会按照「当[情境]，我想[动机]，以便[结果]」的格式生成工作故事，并附带6-8条验收标准。
howto.when: 当你需要编写工作故事、创建JTBD风格的需求项，或表达用户情境和动机时触发。

say.text: 帮我为“每周零食预算”功能写一个工作故事。
say.note: Claude会生成一个完整的工作故事示例。

say.text: 为“在线购物车”功能创建一组工作故事。
say.note: Claude会输出多个工作故事及验收标准。

howto.what_en: Claude generates job stories in the 'When [situation], I want to [motivation], so I can [outcome]' format with 6-8 acceptance criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to write job stories, create JTBD-style backlog items, or express user situations and motivations.

say_en.text: Write a job story for the 'weekly snack budget' feature.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a sample job story.

say_en.text: Create a set of job stories for the 'online shopping cart' feature.
say_en.note: Claude will output multiple stories with criteria.
